reason: Checked the source and listing: in SKY_MODE builds (SKY_MODE = SKY_HELI*(1-DEBUG_FULLREDRAW), any nonzero value) the LDX back (A6 56, zp &56, 3 cycles) at &999E is followed by JSR sky_room (main RAM &3001), whose first act is JSR test -> LDX back; compact (only after a test) takes no X (STZ cp_n, LDA boff, TAY...). After sky_room: BCS masked -> LDX back; sky_put_on starts LDX dm_slot (its SKY_MODE=2 stub CLC/RTS -> BCC masked -> LDX back). So X=back is dead; N/Z dead (sky_room's LDX/CMP/SBC). IF SKY_MODE = 0 is the exact complement of the IF SKY_MODE above, so the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW oracle and SKY_HELI=0 builds keep the LDX their ELSE branch reads. The two NOPs sit after put_on's RTS at &9996, unreachable (entries only put_on and put_on.going_on, the latter by label from render.6502:543; no name+N entries; tools take put_on.going_on from the symbol dump). going_on moves &9997->&9999, BVS offset 1->3 stays in page &99; JSR sky_room stays at &99A0, so nothing after moves: no table, data, zero page, protected line, generated source or ASSERTed region changes, and bank 4's size is unchanged. No paging or ACCCON difference (no memory access removed other than the dead read of zp &56). Render code does not run on the front end; game over, helicopters and completion take the same put_on path with the same contract. Saves 3 cycles per going-on put_on, 0 bytes.
